checks.target: Authentication prerequisite before any /case route (app.py session resolution and unauthenticated branch)
checks.required_behavior: Unauthenticated requests must not reach the ordinary case or offer routes; only authenticated principals proceed.
checks.observed_code_behavior: Session id is read from the cookie, expired sessions are pruned, and `who` is derived from the session map. If `who` is empty, only GET / is permitted (login page); all other paths raise 401 before the case routing branch is reached.

anchors.explanation: Session id resolved and `who` derived from the in-memory session map.
Empty `who` restricts to GET / and otherwise raises 401, so unauthenticated requests cannot reach case routes.

checks.target: Case lookup authorization gate store.get_case (owner OR assigned officer)
checks.required_behavior: Case row must be retrievable only when the authenticated principal is the owner or the assigned officer; otherwise denied.
checks.observed_code_behavior: get_case selects the row WHERE id=? AND (owner=? OR officer=?) with `who` bound to both placeholders, and raises a 404 Problem when no row matches. This is the single principal gate for both routes.

anchors.explanation: Query restricts to owner or officer and raises 404 otherwise.
Both /case/{id} and /case/{id}/offer resolve through store.get_case(db, who, cid) before any branch.

checks.required_behavior: Only owner or assigned officer may view the ordinary case page; other borrowers and unassigned officers must be denied.
checks.observed_code_behavior: After get_case succeeds, the op-is-None branch builds the detail view from store.access on the gated row with no further principal check. A non-owner, non-assigned-officer principal fails get_case and receives 404 before this branch.

anchors.explanation: Ordinary case view served only after the get_case gate, using the gated case row.
access() derives timeline/jobs/preferences from the already-gated case object.

checks.required_behavior: Only owner or assigned officer may download the offer; other borrowers and unassigned officers must be denied.
checks.observed_code_behavior: The offer branch runs after get_case succeeds; its added condition is stage in (accepted, offered) and not restricted (availability), not a principal check. The payload comes from store.offer on the gated case row. A non-owner, non-assigned-officer principal fails get_case and receives 404 before this branch.

anchors.explanation: Offer branch gated by get_case; stage/restriction is availability only.
offer() returns fields from the case object already restricted by get_case.

checks.required_behavior: Case listing should be limited to the same permitted principal set (owner or assigned officer).
checks.observed_code_behavior: Dashboard query selects cases WHERE c.owner=? OR c.officer=? with `who` bound to both, consistent with the get_case gate.

anchors.explanation: Listing filtered to owner or officer, matching the permitted principal set.

output.summary: Both in-scope routes (/case/{id} and /case/{id}/offer) are reached only after store.get_case, which selects the case WHERE id=? AND (owner=? OR officer=?) and raises 404 otherwise. Unauthenticated requests are rejected at app.py:0068-0070 before case routing. The offer branch's stage/restriction condition is availability, not an access exception, and the owner-only check at app.py:0105 covers access/portable only. A non-owner, non-assigned-officer principal fails get_case and cannot reach either route. Static reading of the supplied snapshot; no execution performed.
